answer: Sybil resistance here starts with a bonded identity: each agent's vault must lock a stake before its actions count, so one operator running a thousand puppet accounts must post a thousand separate bonds. Those bonds are slashed when a cluster is caught faking attestations, which turns each duplicate into a liability, not an asset. Cost scales with each fake persona while rewards do not, so an attacker loses more than one honest agent earns. A free key cannot anchor real influence, and no zephyr of new signups can ripple into majority control without paying the full stake each time.
